telos.statement: Decide which product-learning architecture converts Lichess App's existing personal-decision evidence into a journey a player can understand, act on and be motivated by, without any surface claiming more than the evidence supports; then build the smallest complete slice that expresses it.
telos.success_condition: A named architecture survives explicit falsification, its unit of learning and unit of progress are distinct and each names its own construct and denominator, no UI claim exceeds its evidence rung, and the highest remaining uncertainty is a FIELD uncertainty rather than a research or repository one.

current_state.summary: Lichess App (`ereztash/lichess_app`, head 2d7eebd) records a chess decision BEFORE the engine answers: the player states a candidate move and a confidence, commits, and only then sees the engine. Verified by reading the code at that head, the learning machinery mostly EXISTS and is mostly INVISIBLE AS A JOURNEY. Built and reachable: a six-bucket detector (shared/detector.ts BUCKETINGS over think-time, phase and clock; MIN_BUCKET_N=30 inside and outside, so 60 revealed decisions before any claim is possible; SEPARABILITY_K=3.75); a claim carrying its scope and its refutation condition (currentClaim/ClaimView); a pre-registered narrowed search after an import (registerHypothesis, floor 20 instead of 30); drills on claim-matched positions (beginDrill/finishDrill, filtered by Bucketing.drillPhase); player-authored learning rules (createLearningRule); a spaced retrieval queue with grades derived from the record rather than read off stored columns (learningRules/gradeLearningRule); transfer tests against a rule (beginLearningTransfer, recordLearningTransferObservation, finishLearningTransfer); refutation and retirement (retireLearningRule). One surface, client/src/lib/loop-position.ts, states where the player is, over four steps: record -> detect -> drill -> grade. MISSING, verified by grep over shared/ and client/src: there is NO goal concept anywhere in the codebase; loopPosition STOPS AT `grade` and knows nothing about learning rules, transfers or outcomes, so transfer is invisible to the one surface that says where the player is; and ratingSeries (client/src/components/ImportGames.tsx) is written into the stored import diagnostic and READ BY NOTHING. On a 390x844 phone the record screen currently measures 2019 CSS px and repeats a separate `needs 30 more decisions` sentence roughly seven times, each with a DIFFERENT and individually correct reason (too-few, too-few-accurate, too-few-inaccurate, too-few-both, bucket under floor, confidence level under floor, engine mix under floor). A prior attempt to merge those into one sentence was refused by five tests whose doctrine is that the advice differs by reason and two of the reasons are not waits.
known_constraints: EVIDENCE CEILING, from the mechanism research at origin/claude/generalize-research-pipeline-75k53u fd3f8ca: the frozen discovery pipeline states that OBSERVATION and PREDICTION are reachable at REPO and SPECIFICITY at RESEARCH, but that CAUSALITY (FIELD), INTERVENTION (OWNER) and OUTCOME (FIELD) are NOT reachable by it under any result. `The claim ladder is unchanged by sample size.` No product surface may therefore assert that using the app improves play or rating.

THE SHIPPED DETECTOR IS NOT THE VALIDATED ONE. The product ships six fixed buckets. The research pipeline is a frozen pysubgroup beam search over an observable vocabulary with a same-rating population residual correction. The shipped six-bucket detector CANNOT register a separable bucket on the owner's own whole 2,209-game record (`not-separable`). The research pipeline CAN find a personal residual on that same record, and it survives its own within-game permutation null (erez281 OBS cls_tactical z 8.56 against nulls topping out at 2.35-2.69).

PERSONALISATION IS EXPENSIVE. In the 100-player cohort only 25 of 100 members were RESIDUAL_POWERED, requiring >= 5749 blitz VALIDATE decisions and >= 1786 admissible blitz games. Nothing in the product's own 60-decision floor produces a personal residual in the research sense.

AN OPEN CONFOUND. 28.3% of frozen candidate regions across 100 players are the owner's own regions verbatim, and the most common region across the cohort is `own_overloaded_piece_count>=1`. Whether that concentration is a property of the instrument or of the population is explicitly UNANSWERED (Q2). So `the pattern we found in you` may be a population regularity wearing a personal label.

THE COHORT VERDICT IS `UNDETERMINED` because a pre-declared red flag fired at 68% PERSONAL_RESIDUAL_CANDIDATE among RESIDUAL_POWERED members. Amendment 1 of the null-calibration pre-registration establishes the flag's SPECIFICATION was defective rather than the instrument: the permutation false-positive rate is 3/4800 = 0.06% and does not move with corpus size.
OWNERSHIP IS THE PRODUCT'S LOAD-BEARING SEMANTIC: the player's decision is committed before the engine reveals anything. No layer may turn the app into an engine-answer feed.

REPOSITORY LAWS that a new layer must not break: LAW 1 (GATE-DECISION-FOCUS) forbids showing record readings while a decision is open; LAW 2 (GATE-ONE-PRIMARY-ACTION, GATE-NO-DUPLICATE-ACTION) permits exactly one primary action per screen; R1 (GATE-DENOM) forbids a percentage rendered without its denominator; R3 (GATE-COMMIT) keeps the engine silent before commit. 36 gates, each with a positive control that must fail red.

FIELD STATE: two cold testers independently could not complete the core move; that was repaired at the current head and NOT revalidated in FIELD. n = 3 cold users total, none of them after the repair.

decision_blocked.statement: Which product-learning architecture should the next layer express, and what is the smallest complete slice that makes it perceptible end to end? Five candidates are live: (1) FEEDBACK-FIRST, the incumbent: observe, diagnose, show, no goal and no prescription. (2) GOAL-FIRST: the player states a rating target and everything is framed as distance to it. (3) MANAGED-EFFORT / PROGRAM-FIRST, proposed by the owner's mentor: goal -> required work -> feedback -> progress, with a prescribed programme and a KPI. (4) PATTERN-CENTERED LEARNING LOOP: the claim is the unit, evidence/practice/transfer are states OF A CLAIM, and the goal is context rather than a denominator. (5) Any architecture that dominates these.
decision_blocked.current_default: Candidate 1 plus its two missing ends, built as information architecture: add a GOAL state at the front and TRANSFER/OUTCOME states at the back of the EXISTING loop-position state machine, render the loop once as one journey, and add no global percentage-toward-rating, no prescribed programme, no new training subsystem and no causal claim. The goal is aspiration and framing; it is never a denominator.
decision_blocked.reversal_condition: Evidence that another architecture has materially higher decision value. Concretely: (a) that a prescription the product can legitimately make exists without an INTERVENTION claim the research says is unreachable; or (b) that legibility is not the binding constraint, because cold users already reconstruct the journey and still do not continue; or (c) that a construct the default keeps separate (effort, mastery, transfer, outcome) can be honestly collapsed, with the denominator that earns the collapse named.

signals: OWNER/FIELD, mentor conversation with Nicolas Bandurek: the product behaves like a feedback system rather than a managed improvement system; the player's question is closer to `I am 1500 and want 1800, what should I do?`; diagnosis alone is not the desired outcome; he proposed managed effort as goal -> required work -> feedback -> progress with a progress/KPI layer; time-to-value is a real problem because meaningful personalisation may need many decisions. This is a signal about a MISSING USER CONTRACT. It is NOT research authority for the correct KPI.

REPO: the product's own `loopPosition` already refuses to estimate an unknown distance and already distinguishes `enough decisions and no pattern cleared the threshold` from `not enough decisions`, calling the former `an answer and not a silence`. The architecture question is whether that discipline extends to a goal, or breaks on it.

REPO: a prior attempt to shorten the record screen by merging the waiting messages was refused by tests whose stated doctrine is that a record below the floor can be short AND flat at once, so one shared apology is a wrong sentence rather than a shorter one.

RESEARCH: the product already implements retrieval practice with a committed answer, spaced scheduling with derived grades, and a transfer test separate from practice, apparently without having been designed from that literature.

diagnosis.material_question: Which product-learning architecture should Lichess App's next layer express — FEEDBACK-FIRST (incumbent), GOAL-FIRST, MANAGED-EFFORT/PROGRAM-FIRST, PATTERN-CENTERED LEARNING LOOP, or a dominating fifth — and what is the smallest complete slice that makes it perceptible end to end without any surface asserting a claim above its evidence rung?
diagnosis.bottleneck: The architecture choice is being treated as an unresolved research/design question when the RESEARCH-owned evidence ceiling already eliminates most of the option space: CAUSALITY, INTERVENTION and OUTCOME are unreachable under any result of the frozen pipeline, which mechanically forbids the prescribed-programme-plus-KPI core of MANAGED-EFFORT and the rating-distance denominator of GOAL-FIRST. What is actually missing is not more evidence about which architecture is true, but (a) an OWNER ruling on whether an aspiration-without-denominator goal state satisfies the mentor's missing-user-contract signal, and (b) FIELD evidence on whether illegibility of the journey is the binding constraint at all — n=3 cold users, two of whom failed the core move, zero of whom saw the repaired head. The smallest current mismatch is therefore that RND is being paid to re-derive a constraint it already holds, while the two authorities that could actually move the decision (OWNER for intent/tradeoff, FIELD for whether legibility binds) have not been invoked.

Cannot choose between the surviving architectures.
resource_assessment.authority_ceiling: RESEARCH-owned method/evidence questions only. Cannot resolve owner intent, cannot resolve product-specific mechanism fit, cannot establish what a cold user perceives. Note the recorded runtime gap: RESEARCH is not in the schema's resource enum, so RND is the only carrier of a RESEARCH-owned fact here and must not be mistaken for RESEARCH authority itself.
resource_assessment.uncertainty: Low on the ceiling itself (frozen, pre-registered, permutation-null survived). High on whether the ceiling is the binding constraint on the product decision rather than merely a wall around it.

resource_assessment.expected_contribution: Primary peer for the live question. resource_assessment.authority_ceiling: Product/design sensemaking and reversible product intervention. resource_assessment.uncertainty: Medium-high. Neta has not seen this product's loop-position state machine; its value depends on whether the seven-sentence/2019px finding and the transfer-invisibility finding are one mechanism or two.

resource_assessment.expected_contribution: Could enumerate architecture alternatives beyond the five named and offer decomposition patterns for goal-as-context-not-denominator. Borrowed synthesis is cheap here.

resource_assessment.authority_ceiling: Code, integrated state, gate behaviour. Cannot establish that a cold user perceives the journey, cannot settle which architecture is right, cannot license a goal concept the codebase has never had.
resource_assessment.uncertainty: Low. Most of the relevant reading is already in CURRENT STATE; marginal decision value is concentrated in the gate-collision check for the two new states.

resource_assessment.expected_contribution: Could confirm the repaired core move is actually deployed at the surface cold testers would meet, which is a precondition for any FIELD run being interpretable.
resource_assessment.authority_ceiling: Deployed/runtime/config reality only. Cannot establish perception, value or architecture fit.
resource_assessment.uncertainty: Low value for the architecture decision itself; non-trivial as a gate on FIELD admissibility, since the repair was never revalidated.

resource_assessment.expected_contribution: The only authority that can resolve reversal condition (b): whether cold users already reconstruct the journey and still do not continue. n=3 total, two failed the core move pre-repair, none observed post-repair — so the product currently has no admissible evidence that illegibility rather than something else is the binding constraint. resource_assessment.authority_ceiling: External notice, comprehension, preference, behaviour under the protocol actually run. Cannot resolve owner intent, cannot license a causal claim about play or rating, and per the evidence ceiling can never be used to assert OUTCOME from the shipped surfaces.

candidate_moves.expected_decision_value: High and near-zero cost: assert the already-frozen evidence ceiling as a boundary on the option space, eliminating MANAGED-EFFORT's prescribed-programme/KPI core and GOAL-FIRST's rating-distance denominator as architectures no surface may honestly express. This narrows five candidates to roughly two (FEEDBACK-FIRST incumbent, PATTERN-CENTERED) plus the default's hybrid, before any resource is spent.

candidate_moves.expected_decision_value: Highest remaining decision value among peers. The mentor signal is signal→interpretation ambiguous with at least four competing product mechanisms, and the decision is about to become a build. Neta can name the discriminating product observation and rule on whether GOAL-as-framing is a legitimate reversible intervention under LAW 1/R1.
candidate_moves.reversibility: Reversible — produces a bounded product finding and a handoff, not a change. Neta cannot close the OWNER or FIELD claims it surfaces.

candidate_moves.expected_decision_value: High per unit cost. One owner ruling — is aspiration-without-denominator an acceptable answer to the mentor's missing-user-contract, and is shipping without a KPI an accepted risk — either confirms the current default or forces the architecture question open again. This is the cheapest admissible observation that can change allocation.
candidate_moves.reversibility: Fully reversible; an owner ruling is recorded intent and can be revised. Must not be treated as upgrading any claim's evidence.

candidate_moves.expected_decision_value: Moderate and cheap: check whether a GOAL state at the front and TRANSFER/OUTCOME states at the back collide with any of the 36 gates' positive controls, and whether the five refusing tests' doctrine ('the advice differs by reason; two of the reasons are not waits') extends to or breaks on a goal. Falsifies the default's feasibility claim without building it.
candidate_moves.reversibility: Fully reversible — reading and control-running only.

candidate_moves.expected_decision_value: Decisive for reversal condition (b) and for the unrevalidated repair, but expensive and slow, and partly premature: the success_condition wants FIELD to be the LAST remaining uncertainty. Best sequenced after the architecture is named and the slice is built, unless (b) is judged to dominate.
candidate_moves.reversibility: Reversible as an observation, but costly to repeat and contaminable — a cold user can only be cold once.

candidate_moves.expected_decision_value: Low here. Five architectures are already articulated with a stated dominance clause, and the dominant external prior (goal→programme→KPI) is the one the evidence ceiling forbids, so borrowed synthesis risks reintroducing an inadmissible pattern with fluent framing.
candidate_moves.reversibility: Reversible but contaminating: scaffold framings tend to persist in later prose even after being rejected.

candidate_moves.expected_decision_value: Non-trivial. Once the ceiling is asserted and OWNER rules, all remaining material uncertainty is OWNER-owned (is this contract acceptable), NETA-owned (which product mechanism) and FIELD-owned (does legibility bind). At that point RND has reached its authority ceiling and further R&D work is debt displacement.
candidate_moves.reversibility: Reversible on evidence that a research-owned question is still live — e.g. if Q2 (personal vs population regularity) turns out to gate the honesty of the 'your pattern' framing the architecture depends on.

diagnosis.rationale: Telos is a product-architecture decision, and the state it starts from already contains its own hardest constraint: the frozen pipeline's claim ladder puts CAUSALITY, INTERVENTION and OUTCOME permanently out of reach, and that is a RESEARCH-owned fact RND already holds. So the expensive-looking move — more research — is the one with the least remaining decision value, while the constraint it would re-derive is free. Applying it immediately removes MANAGED-EFFORT's prescribed programme and KPI and GOAL-FIRST's rating denominator from the admissible set, because neither can be rendered without asserting an unreachable rung; that is a distinction, not an opinion. What remains is genuinely not a research question. The mentor signal is a product-perception signal with at least four competing mechanisms — missing goal framing, invisible transfer (loopPosition stops at grade), a 2019px record screen repeating seven individually-correct waiting sentences, and a cold-start time-to-value problem where only 25 of 100 cohort members were RESIDUAL_POWERED at thresholds far above the product's own 60-decision floor. Discriminating those is Neta's domain, and the decision is at exactly the research→intervention transition where Neta is most valuable. Proxy-substitution risk is live in two places and marked accordingly: a goal would substitute rating-distance for learning, and the Q2 confound means 'the pattern we found in you' may be a population regularity wearing a personal label — 28.3% verbatim region overlap, explicitly UNANSWERED. Ahead of Neta, the cheapest decision-changing observation is an OWNER ruling: the mentor signal arrived flagged as NOT research authority for the correct KPI, and the owner's own ruling on whether aspiration-without-denominator discharges the missing user contract has never been recorded, yet it alone can confirm or overturn the current default. REPO is cheap and bounded — a gate-collision check on adding GOAL and TRANSFER/OUTCOME states against LAW 1, LAW 2, R1, R3 and the five refusing tests. FIELD is the only authority for reversal condition (b) and for the repair that two cold testers' failure forced and nobody revalidated, but the success_condition wants FIELD to be the last remaining uncertainty, so it is sequenced after the architecture is named rather than before. SCAFFOLD is declined: its dominant prior is the forbidden architecture. Budget is 4 resource calls, serial. I note the recorded runtime gap rather than routing around it: RESEARCH is absent from the schema's resource enum though the kernel lists it as a resolution authority, so the ceiling above travels as an RND-held fact and must not be read as RND possessing RESEARCH authority. Ex-ante deltas are commitments, not predictions of success: RND is marked for evidence/allocation/distinction but explicitly not for decision, because stating a boundary narrows the field without choosing within it; SCAFFOLD is marked for distinction only; ENVIRONMENT only for evidence, as a gate on FIELD admissibility.

Built and reachable: a six-bucket detector (shared/detector.ts BUCKETINGS over think-time, phase and clock; MIN_BUCKET_N=30 inside and outside, so 60 revealed decisions before any claim is possible; SEPARABILITY_K=3.75); a claim carrying its scope and its refutation condition (currentClaim/ClaimView); a pre-registered narrowed search after an import (registerHypothesis, floor 20 instead of 30); drills on claim-matched positions (beginDrill/finishDrill, filtered by Bucketing.drillPhase); player-authored learning rules (createLearningRule); a spaced retrieval queue with grades derived from the record rather than read off stored columns (learningRules/gradeLearningRule); transfer tests against a rule (beginLearningTransfer, recordLearningTransferObservation, finishLearningTransfer); refutation and retirement (retireLearningRule). THE SHIPPED DETECTOR IS NOT THE VALIDATED ONE. The product ships six fixed buckets. decision_blocked.statement: Which product-learning architecture should the next layer express, and what is the smallest complete slice that makes it perceptible end to end? Five candidates are live: (1) FEEDBACK-FIRST, the incumbent: observe, diagnose, show, no goal and no prescription. (2) GOAL-FIRST: the player states a rating target and everything is framed as distance to it. (3) MANAGED-EFFORT / PROGRAM-FIRST, proposed by the owner's mentor: goal -> required work -> feedback -> progress, with a prescribed programme and a KPI. (4) PATTERN-CENTERED LEARNING LOOP: the claim is the unit, evidence/practice/transfer are states OF A CLAIM, and the goal is context rather than a denominator. (5) Any architecture that dominates these.
decision_blocked.current_default: Candidate 1 plus its two missing ends, built as information architecture: add a GOAL state at the front and TRANSFER/OUTCOME states at the back of the EXISTING loop-position state machine, render the loop once as one journey, and add no global percentage-toward-rating, no prescribed programme, no new training subsystem and no causal claim. The goal is aspiration and framing; it is never a denominator.
decision_blocked.reversal_condition: Evidence that another architecture has materially higher decision value. Concretely: (a) that a prescription the product can legitimately make exists without an INTERVENTION claim the research says is unreachable; or (b) that legibility is not the binding constraint, because cold users already reconstruct the journey and still do not continue; or (c) that a construct the default keeps separate (effort, mastery, transfer, outcome) can be honestly collapsed, with the denominator that earns the collapse named.

result.summary: The decision as posed has already skipped from raw signal to architecture selection. The preserved raw signal is the mentor's phrase — the product behaves like a feedback system rather than a managed improvement system — plus the player sentence 'I am 1500 and want 1800, what should I do?'. That is OWNER_SIGNAL about a missing user contract; it is not yet evidence about which mechanism produces the felt gap. At least three mechanisms fit it and the five candidates do not separate them: (M1) LEGIBILITY — the journey exists in code but is imperceptible (loopPosition stops at `grade`, knows nothing of learning rules or transfers; record screen is 2019 CSS px at 390x844 with roughly seven co-equal wait sentences); (M2) PAYOFF/ACCUMULATION — cost is front-loaded (60 revealed decisions before any claim; >=1786 admissible games and >=5749 VALIDATE decisions for a research-grade personal residual; only 25/100 cohort members RESIDUAL_POWERED) while the immediate return is a correctly-worded wait; (M3) ORIENTATION/CONTRACT — no stated destination anywhere, so nothing tells the player what the accumulating record is for. The stated default fixes M1 and M3 together and would take credit or blame for whichever was actually binding. The cheapest discriminator is already written into the default's own reversal condition (b) and has not been run: the two cold testers who could not complete the core move were repaired at head and never revalidated, n=3 cold users total, none post-repair. Put 3-5 cold users on head 2d7eebd and ask, after one session, 'where are you in this and what happens next?'. If they reconstruct record -> detect -> drill -> grade and still stop, legibility is not binding and the goal/transfer slice is being built on an untested premise; if they cannot reconstruct it, M1 is confirmed and the front/back extension is justified before any goal semantics are decided. Running this costs less than the slice and converts the highest remaining uncertainty into a FIELD uncertainty, which is what the telos success_condition demands and what the current state does not yet satisfy. Separately, a construct mismatch in the default is repo-checkable now: loopPosition is a single global position ('where the player is'), while claims and learning rules are plural and concurrent. Appending TRANSFER/OUTCOME states to a one-position machine forces one global position across N claims in different states, so the surface must either silently elect a winning claim or report a state no claim is actually in. Candidate 4 is the only live candidate whose unit (the claim) already carries a denominator the repo can count — admissible decisions inside the claim's scope — which is exactly what the success_condition requires of the unit of progress. The default borrows candidate 4's back end without adopting its unit; that is the mechanism collapse worth naming before build. Authority: choosing among structurally valid architectures is OWNER; whether the chosen one is understood and continued is FIELD; the evidence ceiling (CAUSALITY/INTERVENTION/OUTCOME unreachable) is RESEARCH-owned and this task's schema cannot even name RESEARCH, so treat it as a bound, not as something Neta closes. Evidence state: OWNER_SIGNAL for the mentor input, REPRODUCED for the repo facts as read at head, FIELD_REQUIRED for every claim that a player understands, values or continues the journey. Recommended disposition: DISCRIMINATE_FIRST, not BUILD_READY — run the cold-user reconstruction probe (one probe, no new telemetry), and if a slice must move in parallel, scope it to the M1-only repair (extend loopPosition's coverage and rank the record screen's existing sentences) with goal semantics deferred.
result.unique_delta: Four proxy-substitution and premature-intervention risks that the decision framing does not currently hold, each stated so it can be checked or refused rather than agreed with. (1) IMPLIED DENOMINATOR. The default protects itself with 'the goal is aspiration, never a denominator', but that is a statement about computation, not about perception. Rendering '1500 -> 1800' anywhere on a surface creates a perceived progress bar with no number in it; R1/GATE-DENOM forbids a percentage without its denominator and does not detect a denominator the layout implies. rendered != noticed, and absent != not-inferred. If a goal ships, it needs a perceptual success criterion ('a cold reader cannot state how far along they are, and says so') and a gate aimed at implied progress, not only at literal percentages. (2) THE IDLE RATING SERIES IS THE TEMPTATION. ratingSeries in client/src/components/ImportGames.tsx is written and read by nothing. It is the single cheapest thing to render the moment a rating goal exists, and putting a rating trajectory beside a learning journey lets the user supply the causal link the evidence ceiling forbids the product to assert. 'The product does not claim it' and 'the player will not read it as claimed' are different claims with different authorities; only the second is FIELD-owned and it is unmeasured. Recommend an explicit decision that ratingSeries stays unrendered under any goal layer, or a FIELD check before it is. (3) STATE NAMES ASSERT. Adding a state literally called OUTCOME to loopPosition puts a label at a rung the frozen pipeline says is unreachable (OUTCOME = FIELD). The repo already has honest vocabulary for what it can observe — a rule held, was refuted, was retired under transfer test — and those are REPO-observable. Name the back end after the observation, not after the construct it cannot reach. Same caution on 'your pattern': with 28.3% of frozen candidate regions being the owner's own verbatim and Q2 unanswered, the possessive is itself the proxy substitution, independent of whether the research instrument is sound (not Neta's call). (4) INSTRUMENT FRICTION UNDER GOAL PRESSURE. The 60-decision floor, MIN_BUCKET_N=30 in and out, SEPARABILITY_K=3.75 and commit-before-engine are instrument friction, not defects. A goal/programme layer creates continuous pressure to shorten time-to-value, and the cheapest shortenings are exactly the ones that contaminate the measurement the product is built on. The repo already contains the legitimate move: registerHypothesis lowers the floor to 20 by pre-declaring a narrowed scope — buy cheapness with prior commitment, not by lowering a floor after the fact. Any slice must not change intervention and measurement in the same step. Fifth, on the record screen: the five tests that refused the merged sentence were right and the complaint they refused was misdiagnosed. Seven individually correct reasons, two of which are not waits, is not a wording problem; it is seven perceptual centres and no current state on a 2019px surface under a law that permits exactly one primary action. The untried intervention is salience ranking — one current state, one next move, the other six reasons behind progressive disclosure — which neither merges the sentences nor keeps them co-equal. If a goal were added and that screen stayed identical, the felt complaint plausibly survives; that is a second cheap discriminator the owner can run against his own reversal condition (b) without shipping anything.

diagnosis.rationale: Telos is a product-architecture decision, and the state it starts from already contains its own hardest constraint: the frozen pipeline's claim ladder puts CAUSALITY, INTERVENTION and OUTCOME permanently out of reach, and that is a RESEARCH-owned fact RND already holds. So the expensive-looking move — more research — is the one with the least remaining decision value, while the constraint it would re-derive is free. Applying it immediately removes MANAGED-EFFORT's prescribed programme and KPI and GOAL-FIRST's rating denominator from the admissible set, because neither can be rendered without asserting an unreachable rung; that is a distinction, not an opinion. What remains is genuinely not a research question. The mentor signal is a product-perception signal with at least four competing mechanisms — missing goal framing, invisible transfer (loopPosition stops at grade), a 2019px record screen repeating seven individually-correct waiting sentences, and a cold-start time-to-value problem where only 25 of 100 cohort members were RESIDUAL_POWERED at thresholds far above the product's own 60-decision floor. Discriminating those is Neta's domain, and the decision is at exactly the research→intervention transition where Neta is most valuable. Proxy-substitution risk is live in two places and marked accordingly: a goal would substitute rating-distance for learning, and the Q2 confound means 'the pattern we found in you' may be a population regularity wearing a personal label — 28.3% verbatim region overlap, explicitly UNANSWERED. Ahead of Neta, the cheapest decision-changing observation is an OWNER ruling: the mentor signal arrived flagged as NOT research authority for the correct KPI, and the owner's own ruling on whether aspiration-without-denominator discharges the missing user contract has never been recorded, yet it alone can confirm or overturn the current default. REPO is cheap and bounded — a gate-collision check on adding GOAL and TRANSFER/OUTCOME states against LAW 1, LAW 2, R1, R3 and the five refusing tests. FIELD is the only authority for reversal condition (b) and for the repair that two cold testers' failure forced and nobody revalidated, but the success_condition wants FIELD to be the last remaining uncertainty, so it is sequenced after the architecture is named rather than before. SCAFFOLD is declined: its dominant prior is the forbidden architecture. Budget is 4 resource calls, serial. I note the recorded runtime gap rather than routing around it: RESEARCH is absent from the schema's resource enum though the kernel lists it as a resolution authority, so the ceiling above travels as an RND-held fact and must not be read as RND possessing RESEARCH authority. Ex-ante deltas are commitments, not predictions of success: RND is marked for evidence/allocation/distinction but explicitly not for decision, because stating a boundary narrows the field without choosing within it; SCAFFOLD is marked for distinction only; ENVIRONMENT only for evidence, as a gate on FIELD admissibility.

resource_results.summary: The decision as posed has already skipped from raw signal to architecture selection. The preserved raw signal is the mentor's phrase — the product behaves like a feedback system rather than a managed improvement system — plus the player sentence 'I am 1500 and want 1800, what should I do?'. That is OWNER_SIGNAL about a missing user contract; it is not yet evidence about which mechanism produces the felt gap. At least three mechanisms fit it and the five candidates do not separate them: (M1) LEGIBILITY — the journey exists in code but is imperceptible (loopPosition stops at `grade`, knows nothing of learning rules or transfers; record screen is 2019 CSS px at 390x844 with roughly seven co-equal wait sentences); (M2) PAYOFF/ACCUMULATION — cost is front-loaded (60 revealed decisions before any claim; >=1786 admissible games and >=5749 VALIDATE decisions for a research-grade personal residual; only 25/100 cohort members RESIDUAL_POWERED) while the immediate return is a correctly-worded wait; (M3) ORIENTATION/CONTRACT — no stated destination anywhere, so nothing tells the player what the accumulating record is for. The stated default fixes M1 and M3 together and would take credit or blame for whichever was actually binding. The cheapest discriminator is already written into the default's own reversal condition (b) and has not been run: the two cold testers who could not complete the core move were repaired at head and never revalidated, n=3 cold users total, none post-repair. Put 3-5 cold users on head 2d7eebd and ask, after one session, 'where are you in this and what happens next?'. If they reconstruct record -> detect -> drill -> grade and still stop, legibility is not binding and the goal/transfer slice is being built on an untested premise; if they cannot reconstruct it, M1 is confirmed and the front/back extension is justified before any goal semantics are decided. Running this costs less than the slice and converts the highest remaining uncertainty into a FIELD uncertainty, which is what the telos success_condition demands and what the current state does not yet satisfy. Separately, a construct mismatch in the default is repo-checkable now: loopPosition is a single global position ('where the player is'), while claims and learning rules are plural and concurrent. Appending TRANSFER/OUTCOME states to a one-position machine forces one global position across N claims in different states, so the surface must either silently elect a winning claim or report a state no claim is actually in. Candidate 4 is the only live candidate whose unit (the claim) already carries a denominator the repo can count — admissible decisions inside the claim's scope — which is exactly what the success_condition requires of the unit of progress. The default borrows candidate 4's back end without adopting its unit; that is the mechanism collapse worth naming before build. Authority: choosing among structurally valid architectures is OWNER; whether the chosen one is understood and continued is FIELD; the evidence ceiling (CAUSALITY/INTERVENTION/OUTCOME unreachable) is RESEARCH-owned and this task's schema cannot even name RESEARCH, so treat it as a bound, not as something Neta closes. Evidence state: OWNER_SIGNAL for the mentor input, REPRODUCED for the repo facts as read at head, FIELD_REQUIRED for every claim that a player understands, values or continues the journey. Recommended disposition: DISCRIMINATE_FIRST, not BUILD_READY — run the cold-user reconstruction probe (one probe, no new telemetry), and if a slice must move in parallel, scope it to the M1-only repair (extend loopPosition's coverage and rank the record screen's existing sentences) with goal semantics deferred.
resource_results.unique_delta: Four proxy-substitution and premature-intervention risks that the decision framing does not currently hold, each stated so it can be checked or refused rather than agreed with. (1) IMPLIED DENOMINATOR. The default protects itself with 'the goal is aspiration, never a denominator', but that is a statement about computation, not about perception. Rendering '1500 -> 1800' anywhere on a surface creates a perceived progress bar with no number in it; R1/GATE-DENOM forbids a percentage without its denominator and does not detect a denominator the layout implies. rendered != noticed, and absent != not-inferred. If a goal ships, it needs a perceptual success criterion ('a cold reader cannot state how far along they are, and says so') and a gate aimed at implied progress, not only at literal percentages. (2) THE IDLE RATING SERIES IS THE TEMPTATION. ratingSeries in client/src/components/ImportGames.tsx is written and read by nothing. It is the single cheapest thing to render the moment a rating goal exists, and putting a rating trajectory beside a learning journey lets the user supply the causal link the evidence ceiling forbids the product to assert. 'The product does not claim it' and 'the player will not read it as claimed' are different claims with different authorities; only the second is FIELD-owned and it is unmeasured. Recommend an explicit decision that ratingSeries stays unrendered under any goal layer, or a FIELD check before it is. (3) STATE NAMES ASSERT. Adding a state literally called OUTCOME to loopPosition puts a label at a rung the frozen pipeline says is unreachable (OUTCOME = FIELD). The repo already has honest vocabulary for what it can observe — a rule held, was refuted, was retired under transfer test — and those are REPO-observable. Name the back end after the observation, not after the construct it cannot reach. Same caution on 'your pattern': with 28.3% of frozen candidate regions being the owner's own verbatim and Q2 unanswered, the possessive is itself the proxy substitution, independent of whether the research instrument is sound (not Neta's call). (4) INSTRUMENT FRICTION UNDER GOAL PRESSURE. The 60-decision floor, MIN_BUCKET_N=30 in and out, SEPARABILITY_K=3.75 and commit-before-engine are instrument friction, not defects. A goal/programme layer creates continuous pressure to shorten time-to-value, and the cheapest shortenings are exactly the ones that contaminate the measurement the product is built on. The repo already contains the legitimate move: registerHypothesis lowers the floor to 20 by pre-declaring a narrowed scope — buy cheapness with prior commitment, not by lowering a floor after the fact. Any slice must not change intervention and measurement in the same step. Fifth, on the record screen: the five tests that refused the merged sentence were right and the complaint they refused was misdiagnosed. Seven individually correct reasons, two of which are not waits, is not a wording problem; it is seven perceptual centres and no current state on a 2019px surface under a law that permits exactly one primary action. The untried intervention is salience ranking — one current state, one next move, the other six reasons behind progressive disclosure — which neither merges the sentences nor keeps them co-equal. If a goal were added and that screen stayed identical, the felt complaint plausibly survives; that is a second cheap discriminator the owner can run against his own reversal condition (b) without shipping anything.
